declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K1: the executed functions are read from a real traced run of every task
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K2: S1 containment, rank and space size are measured and compared with the prediction and with the shape ceiling
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K3: S2 (structure completion) is measured in the same way, because it addresses the dominant shape
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K4: the union and its best rank are compared with round 22's 4,581
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K5: contained candidates are executed against the real suite
declared_acceptance_before_the_receipt_r.K6: zero model calls and zero parameters

limits: containment is decided exactly, by the shape of the diff and the membership of its line in the executed functions; nothing is enumerated and nothing is truncated
containment requires byte equality with the fixed file, which is stricter than 'a patch that passes'
S2 adds one element or argument with a word from the file, the machine or the check; it does not compose statements, which is what 13 of the 72 structural fixes do
execution confirmation is run on at most six contained candidates, not on all of them

K2_the_prediction_about_token_search_is_.note_on_rank: rank is reported only where the witness carries its class pool; no space is enumerated, so nothing is truncated and a missing rank is missing, not capped
K2_the_prediction_about_token_search_is_.predicted: containment in the high tens of percent at a cost in the low hundreds
K2_the_prediction_about_token_search_is_.shape_ceiling_from_round_22: 15 of 87 fixes are token-shaped, so no token space can exceed that

K3_structural_generation_from_the_files_.note: the second is the dominant shape: the fix adds a line, and the question is whether that line's text already exists somewhere in the file, which makes it copyable without a generator

K5_containment_is_confirmed_by_execution.note: the claim is not that the text matches but that the machine passes

why_this_round.the_answer_being_tested: if the executed path narrows the space enough, a parameter-free search over the file's own tokens becomes affordable and the shape ceiling is secondary; if not, the ceiling is shape and no search fixes it
why_this_round.the_gap_it_closes: round 25 predicted that path-restricted search would give containment in the high tens of percent at a cost in the low hundreds; this tests it and also tests the assumption behind it, that the fix is a token substitution at all
why_this_round.why_it_could_fail: the path may contain the fix's function without containing the fix's line; only 15 of 87 fixes are token-shaped, which bounds containment at 17% before any search
